correctness.rationale: For odd characteristic, differentiating x_i^2 first forces the scalar term to vanish and forces the quadratic image of x_i to be y_i wedge x_i. Differentiating each anticommutator identifies the coefficients of y_i and y_j in the remaining coordinate. Thus a common y suffices, giving three quadratic parameters; the nine linear and three cubic parameters are free. In characteristic two the algebra is the commutative square-zero-generator quotient and all 21 radical-valued generator coefficients are free. The associated-graded infinitesimal exterior actions are B, tr(B)I-B^*, and tr(B), so higher-degree images do not affect invertibility. After normalizing to trace 1, for transverse prescribed 0- and 1-eigenspaces U,V of total dimension j<3 the space of extensions has 3(3-j) free entries and the single trace equation has nonzero linear part. For j=0,1,2 this yields q^8, -2q^5(q^2+q+1), and q^3(q^2+q+1)(q+3); for j=2 the weighted splitting counts inside a fixed 2-space are q, q(q+1), q. For j=3 the unique map is a projection and the q^{rs} transverse multiplicity times the Möbius factors is -q^3 per choice of the s-space. Its trace is s in the field, giving s=1 always and s=3 only in characteristic two. Combining these terms and multiplying by q-1 and the respective lift counts q^6 and q^12 yields both displayed formulas. A separate exact enumeration set the last diagonal entry to one minus the other two, iterated the eight freely varying entries, and tested determinants by signed permutation expansion (over F4, encode F2[u]/(u^2+u+1)). It gave N(2), N(3), N(4), N(5) = 24, 1998, 30528, 224000. The frozen verification files were inspected, not executed. Finite enumeration does not establish the general census.

evidence: The matrix census is the number of GL(3,q) derangements of trace 1, or the number of matrices with characteristic polynomial x^3-x^2+e2*x-e3 and e3 nonzero, e2 unequal to e3. Equivalently, for invertible trace-one C, tr(C^{-1}) must differ from 1 since e2=e3*tr(C^{-1}).

Fulman–Stanton give the zero-fixed-space mass among all invertible matrices, not in a trace-one fiber. The inspected trace/polynomial distribution theorems give discrepancy or equidistribution bounds rather than the required exact intersection.

value.rationale: Maximal rank on the radical is an intrinsic extremal stratum of ordinary derivations. Its exact size gives the all-q density of radical invertibility in the smallest exterior algebra with a distinct middle exterior action, separating a genuine characteristic-dependent projection count from the elementary change in derivation-space dimension. The joint trace and eigenvalue count is a nontrivial part of the answer and makes this a usable exact benchmark for any broader rank census, not merely an example of the known structure theorem.
